why: E20 part 2: the row's three cost causes and the lane reconciler. Extends the E20 draft scripts/ops/lane_reconcile.py to answer all three on the read it already does, measured 2026-09-22T13:02Z over the 60 most recent sessions: 14 lanes over ceiling (B1 at 12.4x), 22 finished-but-unarchived sessions holding $2,088.73, and 4 BLOCKED lanes holding $1,347.60 of which ONE is $1,343.06 and has never committed a line in 72.8 hours. Makes E20's running-vs-final rule mechanical (fmt_cost refuses a bare figure), adds an --offline half that needs no session state, grandfathers the 15 pre-existing bare spend_usd rows by id following check_soak_registered.py's visible-and-shrink-only pattern, and records that the cheap git-commit-recency signal was MEASURED AND KILLED (5 of 7 WORKING lanes had never committed). Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own list and verifiable against the diff: scripts/ops/lane_reconcile.py (ops tooling, READ-ONLY -- it writes nothing and is wired into no runtime path), .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md (a process doc), docs/claude/work/LANE-WATCHDOG-PROMPT.md (new, registered in DOCUMENT-INDEX.md with its header matching the generated row), docs/DOCUMENT-INDEX.md (one row), docs/claude/work/PIPELINE.jsonl (filed rows), docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json (this lane's own row), and the landing/arming/merge-slot files the self-land route requires. NO src/, no config/, no deploy/, no .github/workflows/, no order path, no strategy params, no risk caps, no runtime behaviour, no DB write, no network call. The script touches no live trading surface at all: it reads one committed JSON and one session dump passed as an argument.
